title: Three-tense frame
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Local area, holiday and travel: town, region and country; holidays (2.3, 2.1)
source: Written for arabic/y10 lesson 9 (Three-tense frame (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 9: Bridge: cultural life: Ramadan and Eid in three time frames. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Ramadan now (present)
points: نَتَسَحَّرُ قَبْلَ الفَجْرِ وَنُفْطِرُ عَلَى التَّمْرِ

panels.title: Eid
points: فِي العِيدِ نُصَلِّي صَلَاةَ العِيدِ وَنَلْبَسُ مَلَابِسَ جَدِيدَةً

parts.text: Present: فِي رَمَضَانَ نَصُومُ وَنُفْطِرُ مَعًا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
Past: فِي العِيدِ المَاضِي زُرْنَا جَدَّتِي وَكَانَ يَوْمًا رَائِعًا.
Future: هٰذِهِ السَّنَةَ سَأَقْرَأُ القُرْآنَ كُلَّهُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ.
Opinion: أُحِبُّ رَمَضَانَ لِأَنَّهُ شَهْرُ القُرْآنِ.

parts.label: Time phrase
parts.text: فِي العِيدِ المَاضِي. Past 'we' of زَارَ: زُرْنَا. Object: جَدِّي وَجَدَّتِي.

questions.q: Translate: Last Eid we visited my grandparents.
questions.a: فِي العِيدِ المَاضِي زُرْنَا جَدِّي وَجَدَّتِي.

questions.q: Core: Write 90 words (portal response box): كَيْفَ تَقْضِي رَمَضَانَ وَالعِيدَ؟ Use three time frames and two opinions.
questions.a: Marked for three time frames (including hollow verbs), festival vocabulary, opinions with reasons and accuracy.

questions.q: Extend (Group B): answer aloud: مَاذَا فَعَلْتَ فِي العِيدِ المَاضِي؟ (unexpected question practice).
Stretch (Group A): give the i'rab of رَائِعًا in كَانَ العِيدُ رَائِعًا.
questions.a: خَبَرُ كَانَ مَنْصُوبٌ وَعَلَامَةُ نَصْبِهِ الفَتْحَةُ (predicate of kana, accusative, marked by fathah)
B) صُمْتُ. Hollow verb: the long ا drops and the first vowel becomes u: صُمْتُ.

questions.q: What is إِفْطَار? A) breaking the fast B) the night prayer C) charity
Big question: write one sentence about Ramadan in each time frame.
